review_candidates.title: SC Planning Master Data Analyst
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Overview The Master Data Analyst is responsible for creating, correcting and maintaining supply chain master data required to execute end-to-end supply planning activities. Reporting to the Category Supply Planner, this role acts as the data integrity owner and collaborates cross-functionally to ensure timely receipt of inputs required to maintain master data, and resolve issues which risk service, inventory, cost or feasibility Responsibilities Creates and maintains accurate, timely supply‑plan
